notes.title: Troll Realm Major Update 0.8.0
notes.notes:
Hello defenders!

The end of Q1 is near, and according to our Roadmap, the time has come to release our first MAJOR update, 0.8.0, also called The Troll Realm update.
We changed a lot, in retrospect, in this form, we should have released Early Access, but let’s not dwell on the past and look at what big changes are coming in “The Troll Realm Update”. 
Focus went on balancing and removing the need to micromanage too many things at once. For one, the heroes now require less management, and their skills have higher damage output but way bigger cooldowns, so their use is now a bit more passive and used as emergency damage burst.

Full Changelog

Content:
[list]
[*] 	10 new levels have been added to the Troll Realm. Rodney and the gang venture into the troll realm to find an ancient relic and meet the troll king to ask him to join their fight against the demons.
[*] 	New playable Hero: Illana
        Illana has the passive ability to increase all towers health by 50% and an auto-attack with high damage output and powerful knockback.
[*] 	New augment runes that change tower targeting: Most Health, Least Health, Last mob, Prioritize Ground units, Prioritize Flying units. All are unlocked by default.
[*] 	New augment rune Snipe, increases tower radius at the cost of attack speed and damage.
[*] 	New enemies: Bog Monster, Demon Sentry, Big Troll, Troll, Enraged Troll, Slug, Blood Slug, Corrupted Slug, Jungle Tiger, Necromancer, Fire Elemental, Fire Lord.
[/list]

Features
[list]
[*] Add a fog of war on all levels and increase camera limits for more free movement.
[*] The tower menu will now close with left click as well.
[*] When placing a new tower, and there’s no free worker, it will take the worker that’s gathering the most resource you have, then it will return to the same type of resource he was gathering.
[/list]

Balancing
[list]
[*] 	Increase Berserker attack speed from 5%/10%/15% to 10%/20%/30%
[*] 	Add knock-up to spike runes attacks
[*] 	Decrease Spike attack rate from 1s to 1.4s
[*] 	Decrease Lightning rune damage percentage for level 3 from 50% to 30%
[*] 	Decrease Lightning rune radius from 500/1000/1400 to 500/600/700 and targets hit from 3/8/12 to 3/6/9
[*] 	Decrease Poison rune damage from 50/100/150 to 25/50/75
[*] 	Gus’s Arcane strike damage tripled, but cooldown increased to 120s
[*] 	Increase Gus’s auto attack damage from 5 to 40.
[*] 	Rodney’s attack abilities' damage tripled, but cooldown increased to 90s, respectively 120s
[*] 	Decrease Rodney’s auto-attack speed from 1s to 1.2s
[*] 	Rebalanced levels 1, 2, 3, 6, 7 and 8
[*] 	Increase all master runes damages:
[list]
[*] Arrow Rune
Level 1: 10 -> 25
[*] Beam Rune
Level 1: 5 -> 8
Level 2: 7 -> 10
Level 3: 10 -> 13
[*] Spike Rune
Level 1: 22 -> 27
Level 2: 28 -> 33
Level 3: 35 -> 41
[*] Boulder Rune
Level 1: 70 -> 150
Level 2: 120 -> 220
Level 3: 160 -> 320
[*] Spear Rune
Level 1: 10 -> 15
Level 2: 16 -> 21
Level 3: 21 -> 33
[*] Sawblade Rune
Level 1: 30 -> 57
Level 2: 35 -> 75
Level 3: 45 -> 101
[/list]
[*] 	Increase rune shards rewards based on enemy health and movement speed.
[*] 	Multi Target augment rune upgraded to Rare rarity and doubled the upgrade costs.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Mortar master runes are correctly displayed in the rewards, and it’s rewarded at level 23
[*] Show level loss warning only if the rune had been upgraded
[*] Fixes a bug where projectile cooldown is ignored if the enemy dies in one shot.
[*] Wrong damage displayed on tower radial stats for poison rune
[*] Fix music resetting itself after 30s in Quick Battle mode.
[*] Fixes low performance on the Quick Battle mode screen.
[*] Increase the size of the resources collision box so it’s easier to click on them
[*] Fixes a visual issue where the projectile slot title in the radial menu was misaligned
[*] Fixes credits screen layout on lower resolutions
[*] Fixes pathing issues in levels 11 and 12
[*] Adds missing icon for Damage over time stat
[*] Completely reworked hero auto attack
[*] Implement enemy knockback animation better
[*] Correctly represent rune stats for Berserker rune that it increases attack speed
[*] Fixes hero ability cooldowns not resetting after a level restart
[*] Fixes a bug where post-processing effects would apply to the map screen if you go to the map screen once a level has started
[*] Increases map screen camera movement speed and increases edges 
[*] Add Spear projectile rune to rewards.
[*] Make knockback always move mobs back on the spline rather than in the direction the hero is facing
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.7.2 out now!
notes.notes:
Hello defenders! Once again, we meet with news of a new update, version 0.7.2 has just been released with some more fixes and improvements.

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[h3]Features[/h3]
-	Added support for DX 11
-	Added more graphics options in Options -> Video, so you can make the game look as terrible (or good) as you want.
-	When first running the game, we start a benchmark to determine if you’re running the game on a toaster, and we set the initial graphics options suited for your hardware.
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
-	Wrong reward was shown in the campaign if the level you just finished had no reward.
-	Worker reward at level 9 was missing from the rewards bar; he is now there, waving at you.
-	Level 9 had a path where ground monsters were flying over the gate…their wings had been cut off.
-	Animation on the map, which unlocks a new level, was painfully slow, we changed its batteries, and now it's three times faster.
-	In level 8, sometimes the prince would materialize at the start of the level into a fence, incapable of moving. He now knows better.
-	Tutorial was asking you to load a rune but was pointing to another; it’s like he wanted you to fail.
-       Redesigned path highlights before a wave starts. The direction of the wave should be much more clear now. No Joke!
-       The stairs in level 10 were too high for the prince to get on them, or he needed to workout more, but in any case, we made them smaller for our highness.

notes.title: Update 0.7.1 released!
notes.notes:
Hello defenders! 0.7.1 is out now with fixes and improvements based on feedback we received from you.

Changelog:
1. Optimized mob shadows, so the game should be more performant when you have many enemies on screen.

2. Redesigned "Under attack notification" and added a shortcut button (default F) to snap the camera to the place where the hero or tower is attacked
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40918865/6dc6dc5330a17fe1a203cade961cdbf7b656dd0f.jpg[/img]

3. After building a tower, if left idle, now workers go to farm a resource of the same type they were farming before instead of the resource you have the least.

4. Improve hero auto-attack; while still not perfect, he starts auto-attacking faster.

5. Implemented Credits screen in the main menu; now you can see the people behind THWN
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40918865/b1746fa7cac3ac9058088f6ac8b7e9d72fcde8e3.jpg[/img]

6. Fixed an issue where incorrect keybindings were set for selecting characters. Now they are correctly set to CTRL+1, CTRL+2, CTRL+3 ... CTRL+9

Thank you,
Join us on Discord to be notified of beta builds and share your feedback with us.

notes.title: 🔴 New demo update 0.6.0 Release NOW
notes.notes:
Hello defenders!

A month ago, we released 0.5.0 with major overhauls, and today, for SteamNextFest we are releasing 0.6.0.

This update includes:
[list]
[*] Revamped player HUD
[*] New build menu added, now you can place a tower, and a worker will come to build it. The worker with no task will come. If all have tasks, the closest one will come to build it.
[*] Workers now start gathering resources automatically at a new level start.
[*] Workers who have completed a build will automatically gather a resource in their radius after 5 seconds.
[*] Dialogue can now be closed and skipped.
[*] More Video Settings
[*] Controls page in Settings where all keys can now be reassigned.
[/list]

As always, join us on Discord if you want to be part of the development and share your feedback.

[url=https://discord.gg/bYFWVj5Wf8]Discord[/url]

notes.title: Summer Demo Update 0.5.0
notes.notes:
The time comes again for a new release. We didn’t stop working this summer, and now it’s time to release version 0.5.0, just in time for Gamescom, Tacticon, and SteamNextFest! Where we will be part of this coming fall.
This update is not small either, numerous improvements have been made and performance improvements:
-	We reworked the particle effects that each tower upgrade brings to the projectile, with less clutter and better visuals.
-	AUTO-ATTACKS. Yes, now the heroes don’t just sit and wait for you to trigger an attack. If left alone, they will attack on their own, not with powerful abilities, of course, but they’ll do some damage.
-	Decluttered the tower radial menu. We’re now showing only the next available tower upgrade instead of all at once.
-	More music added to the levels
-	Reworked how mobs die. Physics is involved.
-	Bug fixes and UI improvements.
And that’s only what you can see in the demo. For the full game, much more happened as we are getting close to an early-access release in November.

notes.title: Biggest DEMO update as of yet
notes.notes:
Hej friends,

We're happy to announce our most significant update to date, where we've reworked several mechanics and did a significant UI overhaul to increase accessibility and make it more intuitive.

This update is big, so I'm going to stick to listing just the main features:
[list]
[*] Major UI overhaul
[*] Runes no longer work as items; instead, they are available for free on all towers if upgraded and runes are unlocked.
[*] Rewards no longer drop during fights, instead, these are unlocked after each level.
[*] PAUSE Button, yes, we know you've asked for it, now you have 3-speed controls that you can switch between with F1/F2 and F3.
[*] lots and lots of bug fixes
[*] performance improvements
[/list]

This update brings us closer to our goal of releasing in early access with 30 levels so don't forget to follow and wishlist the game on Steam.

Thank you all for your continuing support and don't forget to join us on Discord if you want to give feedback.

notes.title: Major Demo release 0.3.0
notes.notes:
Happy Holidays everyone! 

We are happy to announce that our work for the past three months is becoming fruitful, and now, with joy, we're announcing the release of version 0.3.0 of our demo and marking the transition from Pre-Alpha to Alpha stage.

This new version brings new content and a lot of fixes and improvements. To name a few:

[list]
[*] We changed how runes are distributed. There's a drop percentage when killing mobs for common runes, and rare runes are given when finishing a level.
[*] New mob: Champions. They walk the path but have attack damage, attacking towers, and heroes.
[*] Reworked boss in level 3. New abilities and we added a new mechanic on how these abilities display on the screen when you fight him.
[*] The score is displayed in real-time while playing a level. We had also reworked the scoring system. This is why we had to reset all leaderboards.
[*] Improved color grading and over visual effects
[*] We added a tutorial level to show you the basic mechanics of THWN.
[*] Enemy radar now displays tooltips with information about incoming enemies when you mouseover.
[*] Removed quests in level 2. Later quests will be replaced with a new Challenges system.
[*] Improved controls
[*] New ability for Rodney.
[*] And a massive list of bug fixes for which there's no room here to list.
[/list]

The executive producer/dev will stream on Steam and Youtube while playing the demo.

If you've played the demo before, we encourage you to play it again; the experience is very different.

notes.title: Alpha Demo Patch 0.2.4 UPDATE
notes.notes:
In this patch 0.2.4, we fixed a series of issues flagged by the community since the launch of our demo.

Bugs:
[list]
[*] Fix a bug where the loadout wasn't preloaded with all three workers in level 1, making the level impossible to beat by most players.
[*] Fix portrait artwork for workers
[*] We removed the incorrect rarity background for rune shards.
[/list]


Improvements
[list]
[*] We've added a scrollbar to the rewards screen to show more than five rewards when it's the case.
[*] Improved the look&feel of the leaderboard
[*] We moved down the destroy button in the tower radial menu to avoid accidental tower destruction.
[*] Improved quest wording to better guide you in learning the ropes.
[*] We added a missing voice-over for the Queen of Dunnenwaite.
[*] Level 2 wave does not start until the player has completed the first two quests, making the level much easier for new players.
[/list]

We thank you for your continuing support. Your support during the Alpha stage helps us make a better game.
